column1: The disappointing results of many conventional road transport projects in Africa led some experts to rethink the strategy by which rural transport problems were to be tackled at the beginning of the 1980s.
column2: 非洲许多常规道路运输项目的成效令人失望。20世纪80年代初，一些专家因此重新思考解决农村交通问题的策略。
column3: disappointing results|n. 令人失望的成效
column5: road transport projects|n. 道路运输项目
column9: rural transport problems|n. 农村交通问题

column1: A request for help in improving the availability of transport within the remote Makete District of south-western Tanzania presented the opportunity to try a new approach.
column2: 坦桑尼亚西南部偏远的马凯特地区请求协助改善当地交通条件，这为尝试新办法提供了机会。
column4: availability of transport|n. 交通服务的可获得性

column1: The concept of ‘integrated rural transport’ was adopted in the task of examining the transport needs of the rural households in the district.
column2: 在考察当地农村家庭的交通需求时，项目采用了“综合农村交通”这一概念。
column4: integrated rural transport|综合农村交通

column1: The objective was to reduce the time and effort needed to obtain access to essential goods and services through an improved rural transport system.
column2: 项目旨在改善乡村交通，让居民能用更少的时间和力气获得基本物资和服务。
column7: essential goods and services|n. 基本物资和服务
column8: rural transport system|n. 乡村交通系统

column1: The underlying assumption was that the time saved would be used instead for activities that would improve the social and economic development of the communities.
column2: 这背后有一个假设：节省下来的时间会转而用于能够促进社区社会和经济发展的活动。
column8: social and economic development|社会和经济发展

column1: The Makete Integrated Rural Transport Project (MIRTP) started in 1985 with financial support from the Swiss Development Corporation and was co-ordinated with the help of the Tanzanian government.
column2: 马凯特综合农村交通项目（MIRTP）于1985年启动，获得了瑞士发展公司的资金支持，协调工作则得到了坦桑尼亚政府的协助。
column6: with the help of|在……的协助下

column1: When the project began, Makete District was virtually totally isolated during the rainy season.
column2: 项目启动时，马凯特地区一到雨季就几乎与外界完全隔绝。

column1: The regional road was in such bad shape that access to the main towns was impossible for about three months of the year.
column2: 这条区域公路路况很差，以至于每年约有三个月无法通往主要城镇。
column4: in such bad shape|状况如此糟糕

column1: Road traffic was extremely rare within the district, and alternative means of transport were restricted to donkeys in the north of the district.
column2: 当地道路上极少有车辆通行。可选的其他运输方式，也只有这个地区北部使用的驴子。
column3: Road traffic|n. 道路上的车流
column6: alternative means of transport|n. 其他可用的运输方式

column1: People relied primarily on the paths, which were slippery and dangerous during the rains.
column2: 人们出行主要靠这些小路，雨季里路面湿滑，走起来很危险。

column1: Before solutions could be proposed, the problems had to be understood.
column2: 要提出解决办法，得先弄清问题。

column1: Little was known about the transport demands of the rural households, so Phase I, between December 1985 and December 1987, focused on research.
column2: 当时人们对农村家庭的交通需求知之甚少，因此从1985年12月至1987年12月，项目第一阶段的重点是调查研究。
column3: Little was known about|对……所知甚少

column1: The socio-economic survey of more than 400 households in the district indicated that a household in Makete spent, on average, seven hours a day on transporting themselves and their goods, a figure which seemed extreme but which has also been obtained in surveys in other rural areas in Africa.
column2: 对当地400多户家庭的社会经济调查显示，马凯特每户人家每天花在出行和运货上的时间平均为七小时。这个数字看起来高得出奇，但在非洲其他农村地区的调查也得出了同样的数字。
column3: socio-economic survey|n. 社会经济调查

column1: Interesting facts regarding transport were found: 95% was on foot; 80% was within the locality; and 70% was related to the collection of water and firewood and travelling to grinding mills.
column2: 调查发现了一些值得注意的交通情况：95%的出行靠步行，80%在本地范围内，70%与取水、拾柴和前往磨坊有关。
column6: within the locality|在当地范围内

column1: Having determined the main transport needs, possible solutions were identified which might reduce the time and burden.
column2: 在确定主要交通需求后，项目找到了一些可能有助于节省时间、减轻负担的办法。
column4: main transport needs|主要交通需求

column1: During Phase II, from January to February 1991, a number of approaches were implemented in an effort to improve mobility and access to transport.
column2: 在第二阶段，即1991年1月至2月，项目实施了多项措施，力求让居民出行更方便，也更容易使用交通服务。
column8: access to transport|n. 获得交通服务的机会

column1: An improvement of the road network was considered necessary to ensure the import and export of goods to the district.
column2: 为保证货物能运进和运出该地区，人们认为有必要改善道路网。
column7: import and export|n. 货物的运入和运出

column1: These improvements were carried out using methods that were heavily dependent on labour.
column2: 这些改善工程主要依靠人力完成。

column1: In addition to the improvement of roads, these methods provided training in the operation of a mechanical workshop and bus and truck services.
column2: 除了改善道路，这些做法还为当地人提供了有关机械车间运营以及客车、货车运输服务的培训。
column8: bus and truck services|客车和货车运输服务

column1: However, the difference from the conventional approach was that this time consideration was given to local transport needs outside the road network.
column2: 不过，与常规做法不同，这次还考虑了当地公路网覆盖范围以外的交通需求。
column5: local transport needs|当地交通需求

column1: Most goods were transported along the paths that provide short-cuts up and down the hillsides, but the paths were a real safety risk and made the journey on foot even more arduous.
column2: 大多数货物经由山坡上抄近路的小径运送，但这些小径确有安全隐患，也使步行更加艰难。

column1: It made sense to improve the paths by building steps, handrails and footbridges.
column2: 在这些小路上修台阶、装扶手、搭人行桥，是合乎情理的改进办法。

column1: It was uncommon to find means of transport that were more efficient than walking but less technologically advanced than motor vehicles.
column2: 当地很少能见到一种交通工具，效率比步行高，技术却比机动车简单。
column4: means of transport|n. 交通工具
column6: less technologically advanced|技术上较为简单

column1: The use of bicycles was constrained by their high cost and the lack of available spare parts.
column2: 自行车价格高，备件又难找，这限制了它的使用。

column1: Oxen were not used at all but donkeys were used by a few households in the northern part of the district.
column2: 当地完全不用役牛运输，但在该地区北部，有少数家庭用驴。
column4: not used at all|完全不使用

column1: MIRTP focused on what would be most appropriate for the inhabitants of Makete in terms of what was available, how much they could afford and what they were willing to accept.
column2: 马凯特乡村综合交通项目从三方面考虑什么最适合当地居民：当地能得到什么、居民负担得起多少，以及他们愿意接受什么。

column1: After careful consideration, the project chose the promotion of donkeys – a donkey costs less than a bicycle – and the introduction of a locally manufacturable wheelbarrow.
column2: 经过慎重考虑，项目决定推广用驴运输（一头驴比一辆自行车便宜），并引进一种可在当地制造的独轮手推车。

column1: At the end of Phase II, it was clear that the selected approaches to Makete’s transport problems had had different degrees of success.
column2: 到第二阶段结束时，已经可以看出，为解决马凯特交通问题而选用的各种办法，成效并不相同。
column6: different degrees of success|n. 不同程度的成效

column1: Phase III, from March 1991 to March 1993, focused on the refinement and institutionalisation of these activities.
column2: 第三阶段从1991年3月持续到1993年3月，重点是完善这些做法，并使之成为固定制度。

column1: The road improvements and accompanying maintenance system had helped make the district centre accessible throughout the year.
column2: 道路得到改善，又有配套的养护制度，人们因此一年四季都能到达该区的中心城镇。

column1: Essential goods from outside the district had become more readily available at the market, and prices did not fluctuate as much as they had done before.
column2: 在市场上，人们更容易买到来自区外的生活必需品，价格波动也比从前小了。

column1: Paths and secondary roads were improved only at the request of communities who were willing to participate in construction and maintenance.
column2: 只有社区愿意参与修建和养护，并主动提出请求，项目才会改善当地的小路和次要道路。
column5: only at the request of|仅应……的请求

column1: However, the improved paths impressed the inhabitants, and requests for assistance greatly increased soon after only a few improvements had been completed.
column2: 不过，修好的小路给居民留下了深刻印象。才完成几项工程，求助请求就大幅增加。

column1: The efforts to improve the efficiency of the existing transport services were not very successful because most of the motorised vehicles in the district broke down and there were no resources to repair them.
column2: 提高现有运输服务效率的尝试成效不大，因为区内大多数机动车都出了故障，又没有资源维修。
column5: existing transport services|n. 现有运输服务

column1: Even the introduction of low-cost means of transport was difficult because of the general poverty of the district.
column2: 由于当地普遍贫困，就连引进低成本的运输工具也很困难。

column1: The locally manufactured wheelbarrows were still too expensive for all but a few of the households.
column2: 当地制造的独轮手推车仍然太贵，只有少数几户买得起。
column7: all but a few|除少数外的所有人

column1: Modifications to the original design by local carpenters cut production time and costs.
column2: 当地木匠改进了原来的设计，缩短了制作时间，也降低了成本。

column1: Other local carpenters have been trained in the new design so that they can respond to requests.
column2: 当地其他木匠也接受了新设计方面的培训，以便能回应当地人的需求。

column1: Nevertheless, a locally produced wooden wheelbarrow which costs around 5000 Tanzanian shillings (less than US$20) in Makete, and is about one quarter the cost of a metal wheelbarrow, is still too expensive for most people.
column2: 尽管如此，当地产的木制独轮手推车在马凯特售价约为5,000坦桑尼亚先令（不到20美元），约为金属独轮车价格的四分之一，对大多数人来说仍然太贵。

column1: Donkeys, which were imported to the district, have become more common and contribute, in particular, to the transportation of crops and goods to market.
column2: 从区外引进的驴如今在当地更常见了，尤其在把农作物和其他货物运往市场方面发挥着作用。

column1: Those who have bought donkeys are mainly from richer households but, with an increased supply through local breeding, donkeys should become more affordable.
column2: 买驴的人大多来自较富裕的家庭，不过，随着本地繁殖使供应增加，驴应该会更容易买得起。
column4: richer households|n. 较富裕的家庭

column1: Meanwhile, local initiatives are promoting the renting out of the existing donkeys.
column2: 与此同时，当地一些举措正鼓励人们把已有的驴出租。

column1: It should be noted, however, that a donkey, which at 20,000 Tanzanian shillings costs less than a bicycle, is still an investment equal to an average household’s income over half a year.
column2: 不过，要注意的是，一头驴要价两万坦桑尼亚先令，虽比一辆自行车便宜，但这笔投入仍相当于一个普通家庭半年的收入。
column11: over half a year|在半年的时间里

column1: This clearly illustrates the need for supplementary measures if one wants to assist the rural poor.
column2: 这清楚地说明，要帮助农村贫困人口，还需要配套措施。
column8: the rural poor|农村贫困人口

column1: It would have been easy to criticise the MIRTP for using in the early phases a ‘top-down’ approach, in which decisions were made by experts and officials before being handed down to communities, but it was necessary to start the process from the level of the governmental authorities of the district.
column2: 人们很容易批评这个项目在早期采取了“自上而下”的办法：专家和官员先作决定，再将决定传达到社区。但当时确实需要由地区政府这一层级来启动整个过程。
column12: governmental authorities|n. 政府主管部门

column1: It would have been difficult to respond to the requests of villagers and other rural inhabitants without the support and understanding of district authorities.
column2: 如果缺少地区主管部门的理解和支持，回应村民和其他农村居民的诉求本来会很困难。
column3: would have been difficult|本来会很难
column11: district authorities|n. 地区主管部门

column1: Today, nobody in the district argues about the importance of improved paths and inexpensive means of transport.
column2: 如今，改善小路、使用价格低廉的交通工具有多重要，在这个地区已无人争论。

column1: But this is the result of dedicated work over a long period, particularly from the officers in charge of community development.
column2: 但这是长期尽心工作的结果，尤其要归功于那些主管社区发展的工作人员。
column5: over a long period|长期以来

column1: They played an essential role in raising awareness and interest among the rural communities.
column2: 他们在提高农村社区居民的认识、激发他们的兴趣方面发挥了重要作用。
column3: played an essential role in|在……方面起重要作用

column1: The concept of integrated rural transport is now well established in Tanzania, where a major program of rural transport is just about to start.
column2: 综合农村交通这一理念如今已在坦桑尼亚得到广泛认可，当地一项大型农村交通计划即将启动。
column4: integrated rural transport|n. 综合农村交通

column1: The experiences from Makete will help in this initiative, and Makete District will act as a reference for future work.
column2: 马凯特的经验将有助于这项计划，今后的工作也可以马凯特地区为参照。
